ui_bugs.issue: After PIN-gate validates, the call POST /api/wallet/withdraw is made WITHOUT the pin field in the payload. Backend BankWithdrawIn (routers/wallet.py L24-28) declares pin: str as required → FastAPI returns 422 Unprocessable Entity (visible in network: '/api/wallet/withdraw 422'). The PinGate is invoked with onSuccess={submit} (no returnPinToCaller) so PinGate verifies PIN locally via /auth/verify-pin then calls submit() with no PIN to forward. Reference: /app/frontend/app/wallet/bank-transfer.tsx:47-62. Fix: either (a) wire returnPinToCaller={(pin) => submitWith(pin)} on the PinGate and pass pin into the /wallet/withdraw payload, OR (b) drop the pin requirement from BankWithdrawIn (the PinGate already verified). Option (a) is cleaner — keeps backend defence-in-depth via require_pin().

critical_code_review_comments: FLOW-4 ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/app/wallet/bank-transfer.tsx:47-62 — submit() omits pin from the /wallet/withdraw payload. Backend routers/wallet.py:24-28 declares pin: str as required in BankWithdrawIn → 422. The PinGate is invoked at L98-105 without returnPinToCaller, so the PIN never reaches submit(). Choose between: (a) wire returnPinToCaller and pass pin through; (b) relax BankWithdrawIn.pin to Optional[str] = None and rely on /auth/verify-pin called by PinGate. Option (a) preserves defence-in-depth.

rca_of_issue:
FLOW-4 / POST /api/wallet/withdraw → 422 Unprocessable Entity

Reproduction:
  1. Login client@sendbid.app, validate PIN-gate with 123456 → /(tabs)
  2. Navigate to /wallet/bank-transfer
  3. Fill amount=10, holder=John Doe, IBAN=FR7630003000404444444444404, bank=BNP Paribas
  4. Tap bt-submit → PinGate appears
  5. Enter PIN 123456 → /auth/verify-pin returns 200
  6. Frontend then calls POST /api/wallet/withdraw with body {amount, method:'bank', details:{iban,holder,bank,bic}}
  7. Backend responds 422 because pin: str (required) is missing from the payload (routers/wallet.py:24-28 BankWithdrawIn)
  8. UI displays 'Field required' (from apiError parsing the 422 validation error) and stays on the screen — user cannot complete the bank transfer.

Root Cause:
  /app/frontend/app/wallet/bank-transfer.tsx L98 — <PinGate visible={pinOpen} onSuccess={submit} onCancel={...} allowBiometric /> does not provide returnPinToCaller. As a result, PinGate verifies the PIN via /auth/verify-pin and then invokes onSuccess() with no arguments. The submit() function (L47-62) then constructs the /wallet/withdraw payload without a pin field. The backend requires pin in the body, so it 422s.

Fix Options:
  (a) PREFERRED — In bank-transfer.tsx, replace onSuccess={submit} with returnPinToCaller={(pin) => submitWith(pin)} and update submit to:
        const submitWith = async (pin: string) => {
          setPinOpen(false);
          await api.post('/wallet/withdraw', { amount: v, method: 'bank', details: { iban, holder, bank, bic }, pin });
          ...
        }
  (b) Relax backend: change pin: str to pin: Optional[str] = None in BankWithdrawIn AND skip require_pin() (since /auth/verify-pin already validated). Loses defence-in-depth (an attacker with a stolen access token could trigger withdrawals without PIN). Not recommended.

Other findings persist from iter 14 (already reported, no new RCA):
  • 'Unexpected text node' console spam — whitespace inside <View>...{…}</View> JSX.
  • shadow* / pointerEvents / useNativeDriver deprecation warnings on web.
  • Tertiary screens partially translated.
